methodology: Existing currentOpportunity() logic. Additional shortlist: all 4 conditions, at least INR 10 crore observed session value, price >=20, at most 2% above approximate VWAP. Ties ordered by observed session value. Latest shortlisted quotes re-fetched.
limitations: Uncalibrated momentum screen; no probability estimates.
Breakout/target/stop are illustrative planning levels, not a validated execution strategy.
Historical liquidity audit bundled by the application may be stale; shortlist uses observed current-session turnover.
